units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 6:8:4">Y. Shebu. VI, end, 37ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ שבועה</he> the desecration committed by an unnecessary oath.
Sabb. 33ᵃ, a. fr. ח׳ שבת desecration of the Sabbath; ח׳ השם defamation of the Name of the Lord, disgracing the Jewish religion.
<cite ref="Yoma 86a:9">Yoma 86ᵃ</cite> <he>ה״ד ח׳ השם</he> what act, for instance, would be a profanation &c.?—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 40a:20">Kidd. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>אין מקיפין בח׳ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="N01233"><he>נָקַף</he> I</cite>, II.

senses.gloss: redemption of sacred objects, secularization. Ib. 35ᵃ טעון ח׳ requires redemption.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 2:1:4">Y. Naz. II, beg. 51ᵈ</cite> <he>משמשין לשון ח׳</he> mean redemption; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חִילּוּלִים</he>, <cite ref="H00764"><he>חִלּ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 7:5:4">Y. Peah VII, 20ᵇ</cite> bot. (interpret. <he>הלולים</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 19:24">Lev. XIX, 24</cite>), v. <cite ref="E00004"><he>ה״א</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: the loss of priestly status, becoming a ḥalal (v. חָלָל II).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 7:2:3">Y. Ter. VII, 44ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>את שחִילּוּלָהּ וכ׳</he> whose loss of priesthood was caused by &c.—Pl. <he>חִילּוּלִין</he>, <cite ref="H00764"><he>חִלּ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Ketubot 29b:9">Keth. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ הוא עושה</he> he causes loss of priesthood (to his offspring).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 50b:18">Snh. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>בחִילּוּלֵי שבזנות וכ׳</he> the text speaks of desecration effected through illicit intercourse (not of Sabbath breaking).—[Sifré Deut. s. 26, v. <cite ref="H00764">preced.</cite> w.]
